bibliographic.title: Cottage of Hazy Memories
bibliographic.author: patsitive
bibliographic.description:
GAME UNDER CONSTRUCTION. 💗
---
You've lived in this cottage most of your life. First, with your parents. Then with your avaunt. Many doors were locked and many questions left unanswered.

But they're all gone.

Now, you have the keys. You can find the answers.

Why were the doors always locked?

Why was someone always watching you?

And what is that weird energy that seems to buzz inside the house?

---

This is a choice-based Interactive Fiction game, which I built using Twine (It's my first Twine game~!). It is based on my playthrough of the solo journalling game Call from the Past.  Essentially, if you play this, then you are experiencing my Actual Play of that game!

- I played Call from the Past as part of the Sunflower Solo Club jam #2

- There is no added formatting or added media, as part of the Bare Bones Jam '25 (I did use built-in formatting in Chapbook, such as 'preformatted', 'bold', and 'italics')

Feedback and comments will make me fizz up like when you drop menthol candies into a bottle of soda. So, if you want a grown woman to be a geyser of joy, then please leave a comment. 💗💗💗

(I am currently still updating this, so your patience is very much appreciated 🥰😅)

Ngā mihi nui | Kind regards | Mabait na pagbati,
